hook.name: HoodsHook
hook.description: Singleton ETH-fee hook for hoods.meme token pools. Takes a market-cap-tiered ETH fee on each swap (max 1% of ETH moved), accruing fees separately for a treasury and a per-token creator splitter; fees are pulled later so no external call occurs in the swap path. Sell-exactOut swaps are rejected. Fee schedule is factory-snapshotted at pool launch and immutable thereafter.
